bullets.text: Chennai recorded heavy overnight rainfall causing waterlogging and school closures, and the office should monitor GCC complaints and relief efforts.
Power supply will be suspended in parts of Velachery for maintenance work, and the office should watch for local disruptions.
Thiruvallur district is holding a pension adalat on the 20th to resolve pensioner grievances, and the office should track proceedings.
Chennai residents are urging the civic body to intensify fogging due to a monsoon mosquito surge, and the office should watch sanitation responses.

stories.title: Chennai Heavy Rain: Vadapalani Records 132.9 mm; Schools Closed, GCC Receives 1,212 Complaints
takeaways: Vadapalani recorded 132.9 mm of rainfall while the Greater Chennai Corporation received 1,212 public complaints.
Authorities declared school holidays and deployed drainage teams to clear inundated residential neighbourhoods.

stories.title: Power Shutdown Areas in Chennai - Wednesday (30-09-2026)
takeaways: Power supply will be suspended in Velachery including Rettaipillaiyar Koil Street and Bharathi Street on Wednesday.
Maintenance work will interrupt electricity from nine in the morning until two in the afternoon.

takeaways: Thiruvallur district administration has announced a special Pension Adalat to resolve grievances for retired personnel on the 20th.
Pensioners can submit petitions regarding delayed benefits or pension revisions for immediate official review.

stories.title: Mosquito menace bites hard, Chennai residents call for intensified fogging
takeaways: Monsoon rains have triggered a surge in mosquitoes prompting Chennai residents to demand intensified fogging.
The civic body must ramp up vector control operations to prevent health risks in neighborhoods.
